title: 공항에서의 귀빈 예우에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Procedures for Use of VIP Lounges)
(1) A person intending to use a VIP lounge (in the case of a foreign national, the inviting person or proxy handler of immigration procedures; the same shall apply hereinafter) shall apply for use at least 24 hours before the scheduled time of use to the President of Incheon International Airport Corporation in the case of Incheon International Airport, or to the President of Korea Airports Corporation in the case of any other airport. <Amended on September 26, 2016>
(2) Upon receiving an application under paragraph (1), the President of Incheon International Airport Corporation or the President of Korea Airports Corporation shall assign a VIP lounge and notify the applicant and the heads of agencies responsible for immigration inspection affairs, including the head of the customs office.
